title: 2000亿美元：机器人市场蓝图，欧洲能兑现吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: You are watching Bloomberg Tech Europe coming up. AI gets physical, we ask where the robots are finally ready to move out of the lab and into our workplaces and homes.
segments.zh: 您正在收看彭博科技欧洲节目。AI走向实体化，我们探讨机器人是否终于准备好走出实验室，进入我们的工作场所和家庭。

segments.en: There is big money behind the humanoid hype. Can their technology really deliver on a potential 200 billion dollar market over the next decade?
segments.zh: 人形机器人热潮背后有巨额资金支持。在未来十年，这项技术真的能实现2000亿美元的市场潜力吗？

segments.en: A new era of robotics is taking shape. We meet some of the European companies determined to be part of it.
segments.zh: 机器人技术的新时代正在形成。我们采访了一些决心参与其中的欧洲公司。

segments.en: If you look at the physically eyepiece, it's tremendous. So it's like something, even I can tell what happens in one year.
segments.zh: 如果你看看物理上的进展，那是巨大的。就像某些东西，甚至我能预见到一年内会发生什么。

segments.en: I mean, it's ridiculous. It's fast. It's, it's, it's, it's fixed on, and, and it's real.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这太不可思议了。速度飞快，它固定住了，而且它是真实的。

segments.en: We will be speaking to leading figures then in the robotics space, including Barclay's head of thematic fixed income research.
segments.zh: 我们将与机器人领域的领军人物对话，包括巴克莱主题固定收益研究主管。

segments.en: So it's a daughter over who says we are entering, quote, the decade of the robot.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个女儿，她说我们正在进入所谓的“机器人十年”。

segments.en: Google deep minds head of robotics, Carolina Parada, Europe Robotics CEO David Riga, and Robotics co-founder Joanna Katochi.
segments.zh: 谷歌DeepMind机器人部门负责人卡罗琳娜·帕拉达、欧洲机器人公司CEO大卫·里加，以及机器人公司联合创始人乔安娜·卡托奇。

segments.en: Welcome to Bloomberg Tech Europe. So are we on the cusp of a new robot reality?
segments.zh: 欢迎收看彭博科技欧洲。那么，我们是否正处于新机器人现实的前沿？
